content.short: Trust Wallet is a leading multi-chain wallet that supports TON, allowing users to manage Toncoin and Jettons globally.
content.description: Trust Wallet is one of the world's most popular multi-chain, non-custodial wallets, providing support for millions of assets across over 100 blockchains, including TON. It enables users to securely manage Toncoin and Jettons alongside their other crypto holdings. With its integrated dApp browser and secure storage solutions, Trust Wallet serves as a versatile portal for users to interact with the broader Web3 ecosystem while maintaining sovereignty over their private keys.
content.meta: Manage your TON assets with Trust Wallet, the world's leading multi-chain wallet. Explore more Web3 tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
